title: When defer looks
hints: The arguments of a deferred call are evaluated when the defer statement runs, not when the deferred function runs. At that moment last is still "".
Defer a closure instead: defer func() { … }(). The closure reads last when it runs, at the very end. To change what Run returns from a deferred function, the result must be named.
func Run(steps []string) (log []string) { last := ""; defer func() { log = append(log, "cleanup after "+last) }(); for _, s := range steps { log = append(log, "run "+s); last = s }; return log }
